purpose: Frozen C200 semantic/process path substitution on a fixed existing diagnostic task panel
task_choice: same pre-existing balanced eight-task mechanistic panel used before this experiment; no current-result filtering

arms.process_wrong: correct-video S; cross-suite wrong-video P4 and its presented times
arms.process_static: correct-video S; repeat-first-frame P4 with original timeline
arms.process_zero: correct-video S; zero P4 values of the same shape and original timeline
arms.semantic_wrong: cross-suite wrong-video S; correct-video P4 and timeline

references: Reuse already registered C200 full correct, wrong_cross_suite and static_first adapters/rows for these same tasks
donors: exact full train24 donor mapping from parent panel; exact TARGET language retained
native_forward: recompute all real frames before collecting S/P4; no cached updated R from other checkpoint
interpretation: A frozen path substitution tests contribution in this checkpoint and these tasks. It is not a training recipe, deployed wrong-video gate, or proof the substituted distribution is on-manifold. Correct process advantage over wrong/static/zero with S held fixed supports actual beneficial use; small/no benefit motivates examining representation/credit before changing task coverage. A harmful zero ablation alone does not prove temporal semantics.
